description: Erection of a two storey building comprising of 2 X 1 bedroom flats with ancillary car parking spaces
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 3 - No windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east or west walls of the building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until full details of hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and have been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing materials; minor artefacts and structures, proposed and existing functional services above and below ground. Soft landscape works shall include planting plans, written specifications, schedules of plants, plant sizes, species and densities, and a programme of implementation.

Condition : 6 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The building shall not be occupied until a means of vehicular access has been constructed in accordance with the approved plans.

Condition : 8 - Before development commences details of sight lines at the point of access to the public highway shall be submitted to and shall be approved by the Local Planning Authority, and the development shall be carried out only in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 9 - The car parking provision shown on Drawing No. KJT/Finch/001(b) for the proposed new residential units shall be provided before the residential units to which it relates are first occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 10 - Details of the amenity space allocation between the units shall be submitted to and shall be approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development, and the approved allocation shall be implemented as approved on the first occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained.

Condition : 11 - The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until details of the arrangement for the storing and recycling of refuse or waste have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details shall be implemented as approved on the first occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained.

Condition : 12 - Details of all boundary walls and fences shall be submitted to and shall be approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development, and the approved details shall be implemented as approved and shall thereafter be retained.

Condition : 13 - Notwithstanding the details of the internal layout of each flat as submitted, the floor layouts shall be provided in accordance with the requirements of Lifetime Homes, and shall thereafter be retained as such.
